values.note: Bay County: modern campsite $33 any night of the week, one rate for everyone; 'Price does not include vehicle permit fees' (day-use vehicle permit $4, annual $20, senior annual $15; all permits are paid at check-in). Extended stays: week $195, month $575, three months $1,400, five months $2,250. Log cabins $75 a night.

values.note: Reserve by phone or by the online request form (a ranger calls back; the form does not guarantee a site), held by credit card or advance payment, for the current calendar year only. Reservations are recommended May-September, when the campground is typically full every weekend; October-April they are not needed. Late arrivals pay at the office door's overnight payment slot before setting up. Long-term sites (1 week to 1 year) are limited to specific sites and currently have a waiting list. Cancel at least 7 days ahead. Renters must be 21. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 2 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.baycountymi.gov/recreation/pinconning_park/faq_frequently_asked_questions.php ('Campsite Reservation Policy', 'Long-Term Campsite Reservation Policy', 'an overnight payment slot is attached to the front door') + reservation_form.php ('filling out this form DOES NOT guarantee you a reservation') + rules_and_regulations.php, read 2026-10-22

note: Bay County park on Saginaw Bay (3041 E Pinconning Rd): wooded or sunny sites, 12 with concrete pads; six heated log cabins rented year-round; boat launch and channel, small beach (no lifeguard), fishing dock, observation towers, boardwalks and trails in a 206-acre nature preserve. The shoreline is coastal wetland, and Lake Huron's water level decides how good the swimming and boating are. --Claude
summary: Bay County's park pages confirm $33 any night (plus a $4/day vehicle permit, recorded as entrance), 62 sites with 20/30A and some 50A, water at sites 1-42, showers and septic station, campsites open year-round (reservations not needed Oct-Apr), reservations by phone or online request form. Cleared the derived fcfs 'never' (walk-ups pay at the overnight slot; 'reservations required' in the note was wrong). Note cleaned of the site, hookup, booking and season text the fields hold. Phone (989) 879-5050 matches. Long-term sites exist (waiting list) but are limited to specific sites.
